data.name: Arnoldo
data.gender_notes: Arnoldo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Arnoldo originated from the Latin word 'arnoldus', which means 'eagle power' or 'strong as an eagle'. This name was given to boys who were believed to possess the strength, courage, and determination of an eagle. The name Arnoldo carries the meaning “Powerful as a warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arnoldo usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful as a warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
